description: Additive, ID-preserving prompt-quality overrides. Base master library remains unchanged.

overrides.prompt:
Create an exactly 10-second vertical 9:16 product video for the user-supplied shoe product name. Creative direction: a natural on-foot walking showcase with a calm, realistic commercial look. Use one adult wearer and a flat, dry, uncluttered walking surface. Keep the shoes as the clear subject; avoid dramatic posing or a fashion runway unless explicitly requested.

PRODUCT ACCURACY: Use only details supported by the product name and visible scene. Keep the shoe silhouette, colour, pattern, visible markings, fastening and sole outline consistent across every shot. Do not invent materials, cushioning, grip, waterproofing, comfort, durability or performance claims. Do not add logos, accessories, extra shoes or readable text. Keep both feet anatomically plausible and grounded; no sliding, foot twisting, floating, duplicated footwear or shape changes.

EXACT 10-SECOND SHOT PLAN:
0–2s | Establish the shoe: Start at a low three-quarter angle with the shoes clearly visible on the wearer's feet. Use a gentle camera push while keeping the full shoe outline readable.
2–6s | Walking action: The wearer takes two or three slow, natural steps on the flat surface. Track smoothly alongside the feet; show believable heel-to-toe contact and weight transfer without exaggerated movement.
6–8s | Visible detail: Move briefly closer to the visible upper, fastening or side profile. Show only details supported by the product name and scene; do not force an unnatural foot turn to reveal the sole.
8–10s | Final hero: The wearer stops with both feet naturally planted. Hold a clean, steady view of the unchanged shoes and their silhouette.

CAMERA AND SOUND: One coherent location, natural light, realistic contact shadows, restrained camera movement and clean transitions. No jumpy cuts, warping, artificial speed streaks, on-screen text, captions, added logos or watermarks. No dialogue or voice-over; use subtle instrumental music only if audio is supported, kept below natural ambience.

Do not invent material, construction, hidden details, logos or performance claims. 0–2s | Clean reveal: Begin with the complete shoe or pair in a low three-quarter view, using a soft light sweep or gentle camera push to reveal the real outline.

8–10s | Hero finish: Return to the same complete product and original arrangement. Let the camera settle and hold a clean final frame.

CAMERA AND SOUND: Soft directional light, realistic contact shadows, restrained reflections and smooth movement. Keep the background and product position consistent; no abrupt cuts, artificial sparkle, morphing or floating objects. No dialogue or voice-over; subtle instrumental music only if audio is supported, below natural ambience.

overrides.prompt:
Create an exactly 10-second vertical 9:16 product video for the user-supplied shoe product name. Creative direction: a close, natural demonstration of the shoe's fastening and first step. Use a simple, tidy setting with the footwear as the clear subject; no study desk, books, paper or unrelated stationery props.

PRODUCT ACCURACY: Preserve the shoe's stated silhouette, colour, pattern, visible markings and construction. Show laces only if the named shoe has laces; otherwise, focus on the actual fastening or visible upper without inventing one. Do not invent materials, hidden features, logos, accessories or performance claims. Hands and feet must move naturally, and the shoe must retain the same shape and fastening arrangement throughout.

EXACT 10-SECOND SHOT PLAN:
0–2s | Shoe introduction: Start with the complete shoe in a low three-quarter view on a stable surface, with the fastening and overall silhouette visible.
2–6s | Signature action: If laces are present, a hand makes one small, plausible adjustment without changing their route or count. If not, show a gentle touch near the actual fastening or a slow camera move across the visible upper. Do not force an action the product cannot support.
6–8s | Side detail: Track briefly along the visible upper and sidewall or sole edge. Do not flip the shoe or invent hidden tread, labels or construction.
8–10s | First step and finish: If a wearer is included, show one short, controlled step on a flat surface and settle naturally; otherwise keep the shoe grounded and return to a clean full-product view. Hold the final frame steady.

CAMERA AND SOUND: Smooth close-up movement, natural light, realistic contact shadows and consistent shoe geometry. No abrupt transitions, floating objects, extra laces, distorted hands, on-screen text, captions, added logos or watermarks. No dialogue or voice-over; subtle instrumental music only if audio is supported.
